review.tagline: Agent harness adding swarms, memory and hooks to Claude Code and Codex
review.summary: Ruflo is a TypeScript layer around Claude Code and Codex. `npx ruflo@latest init` adds agent definitions, hooks, a memory store and an MCP server to the project, and the same pieces are also published as 48 Claude Code plugins. It also ships a console UI for inspecting agent runs, plus federation between machines.
review.audience: Claude Code and Codex users wanting multi-agent swarms and persistent memory
strengths: One command, `npx ruflo@latest init`, sets up agents, hooks, memory and MCP server
Plugin-only install route adds no files to the project workspace
Works with Codex and other MCP clients via `npx -y ruflo@latest mcp start`
Console limits Claude control to read/write/manage/full levels, default read with ask approval
weaknesses: Very large surface: 406 MCP tools, 61 CLI commands and 48 plugins to understand
Full loop needs the CLI install, which writes .claude/, .claude-flow/ and CLAUDE.md
Mods are not sandboxed and run with your account's permissions
Plugin route requires Claude Code 2.1.287 or later
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), Claude Code 2.1.287+ for plugin install
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, DeepSeek, Ollama
